sources.title: DRV MOD 1 (WHITE) – 1981 Inventions
sources.excerpt: Manufacturer identifies the product as the original V1 circuit configuration, technically a prototype, with through-hole components on the original PCB, OPA2134 option, zero-gain mode, current hand assembly in Nashville and 9V standard power.

sources.title: DRV MOD 1
sources.excerpt: Matthew Hoopes documents the MOD 1 deep dive and approximately 100-unit final run, plus TL072, NE5532 and OPA2134 socketed op-amp choices and their described tonal differences.

sources.title: Which 1981 Inventions DRV Are You??
sources.excerpt: Independent comparison distinguishes MOD 1 from OG DRV and other DRV variants; describes zero-gain mode as preamp-only operation.

sources.title: 1981 Inventions DRV Overdrive MOD 1
sources.excerpt: Secondary listing reproduces three interchangeable op-amp choices and compares MOD 1 as darker, warmer and fatter than standard DRV.

sources.title: informant / DRV MOD 1
sources.excerpt: Community technical analysis discusses the reduced-gain modification and reproduces the official op-amp options. Treated as supporting technical evidence, not primary production documentation.
